2.web: “Do you think this to be your right, or do you say, ‘My righteousness is more than God’s,’
2.asv: Thinkest thou this to be thy right, Or sayest thou, My righteousness is more than God’s,

3.web: That you ask, ‘What advantage will it be to you? What profit shall I have, more than if I had sinned?’
3.asv: That thou sayest, What advantage will it be unto thee? And, What profit shall I have, more than if I had sinned?

4.web: I will answer you, and your companions with you.
4.asv: I will answer thee, And thy companions with thee.

5.web: Look to the heavens, and see. See the skies, which are higher than you.
5.asv: Look unto the heavens, and see; And behold the skies, which are higher than thou.

6.web: If you have sinned, what effect do you have against him? If your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him?
6.asv: If thou hast sinned, what effectest thou against him? And if thy transgressions be multiplied, what doest thou unto him?

7.web: If you are righteous, what do you give him? Or what does he receive from your hand?
7.asv: If thou be righteous, what givest thou him? Or what receiveth he of thy hand?

8.web: Your wickedness may hurt a man as you are, and your righteousness may profit a son of man.
8.asv: Thy wickednessmay hurta man as thou art; And thy righteousness may profit a son of man.

9.web: “By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out. They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.
9.asv: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out; They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.

10.web: But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,
10.asv: But none saith, Where is God my Maker, Who giveth songs in the night,

11.web: who teaches us more than the animals of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?’
11.asv: Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth, And maketh us wiser than the birds of the heavens?

12.web: There they cry, but no one gives answer, because of the pride of evil men.
12.asv: There they cry, but none giveth answer, Because of the pride of evil men.

13.web: Surely God will not hear an empty cry, neither will the Almighty regard it.
13.asv: Surely God will not hear an emptycry, Neither will the Almighty regard it.

14.web: How much less when you say you don’t see him. The cause is before him, and you wait for him!
14.asv: How much less when thou sayest thou beholdest him not, The cause is before him, and thou waitest for him!

15.web: But now, because he has not visited in his anger, neither does he greatly regard arrogance.
15.asv: But now, because he hath not visited in his anger, Neither doth he greatly regard arrogance;

16.web: Therefore Job opens his mouth with empty talk, and he multiplies words without knowledge.”
16.asv: Therefore doth Job open his mouth in vanity; He multiplieth words without knowledge.
